scope_note: Agent review on 2026-10-16 inspected current main and recent batches, repository structure/instructions, active task/claim contract, source/media and receipt schemas, the two-source nitrogen-toxicity profile, tests and CI. Re-read original Saloner and Bernstein 2022 Frontiers study, including methods, Results, Figure 1 caption and discussion. Title/authors/publisher/DOI/publication date 2022-06-01 retained; access updated to 2026-10-16. Corrected the blanket symptom-free 0-30% ammonium description to retain the reported nitrate-only dotted marginal chlorosis. Added three exact primary-supported claims and three capture/confirmation stages: root-base brown material is residual coconut fiber rather than a scored root-necrosis endpoint; day-45 physiology versus day-59 mineral sampling and final-week fertilizer-free distilled-water history; paired input versus divergent leachate pH. Annotation safeguards are conservative inferences from these documented scope limits, not experimentally validated camera tests. Do not infer a symptom-free negative control, matched-time assays, withdrawal rescue, flushing benefit, a pure unconfounded injury mechanism or universal concentration/timing threshold. Keep residual medium separate from root tissue and plant/sample identity linked through capture, assays and intervention history. Total-nitrogen and nitrogen-form pathways remain distinct; photo-only cap remains 0.15. No new citations, media, binaries, licenses, permission grants or training admissions; one existing citation enriched. Existing media and review restrictions preserved. Totals unchanged: 63 profiles, 199 sources, 92 media references, 36 originals and 68 crops, zero training-eligible media. Fresh full run passed 289 tests, all 62 package validators, type check, build, artifact-hash verification and git diff check. Exports and frozen model-data pins synchronized; 191-row frozen text mixture is not a model-training run. PHP unavailable locally; hosted CI lint required before integration. Verification-before-completion gated publication. Local task claim retained through review and released after integration, without publishing an operational claim as canonical data. Remaining gaps: matched-time plant-linked imagery and assays, calibrated root/leaf captures, independently confirmed alternative causes, treatment-specific longitudinal video and recovery follow-up. Symptom-only, root-color-only, unmatched-time or unlinked-treatment samples retain low-confidence human review. Agent review is not human/expert/laboratory verification. No production deployment or overall completion claimed.
